svg.title: Who gets through the storage firewall to labshare
svg.desc: vm-files mounts labshare at /mnt/labshare over SMB 3.1.1 on port 445; its subnet snet-vms reaches the account through a Microsoft.Storage service endpoint, and the …files firewall denies everything except snet-vms. Browsing the share from the portal at home is refused until you add your client IP to the firewall.
